page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: The normal value
steps.why: The P-R interval measures how long the signal takes to travel from the atria to the ventricles.
steps.margin_note: Normal first, then what a long one means.
lines: The normal P-R interval is 0.12 to 0.2

steps.label: What a long one means
steps.why: A longer interval means the impulse is being held up somewhere between the two nodes.
common_mistakes: Saying it indicates a faster heart.
steps.memory_tip: A long P-R means the signal is delayed from SAN to AVN.

lines.text: A long P-R means delay from SA node to AV node

insider_note: Give the normal value first. Without it there is nothing for 'prolonged' to be measured against.
